SPECS Overall Dimensions & Capacity Overall (L × W × H): 4,681 mm × 1,802 mm × 1,415 mm Wheelbase: 2,735 mm Seating Capacity: 5 persons

Engine / Powertrain (Hybrid — RS e:HEV) Engine + Motor system, full-hybrid (gas + electric) Combined/Hybrid output & torque
Chassis, Suspension, Brakes & Wheels (Turbo-gas / RS) Front Suspension: Independent, MacPherson Strut Rear Suspension: Independent, Multi-link Brakes (Front / Rear): Vented Disc / Disc Wheels & Tyres (for some trims): Alloy wheels with 235/40 R18 tyres
Features & Equipment (varies by trim) Infotainment: 9-inch touchscreen, smartphone connectivity (Apple CarPlay / Android Auto) available on higher trims CarGuide+2Zigwheels Safety & Driver-Assist: Includes systems under Honda SENSING — e.g. collision mitigation, lane-keeping assist, adaptive cruise control where equipped.
